name: Holographic Display System
definition: A scalable hardware and software system for multi-user interactive computer graphics that uses an array of micro-displays and a holographic screen to emit light beams of different color and intensity in controlled directions, composing a continuous 3D view.
summary: A scalable system using micro-displays and a holographic screen to emit directional light beams, creating a 3D view with horizontal-only parallax while avoiding the heavy computational load of full volumetric wavefront synthesis.
